title: Cured fish and fisheries products - Processing and storage - Code of Practice
clause_1_scope: This code provides the technological guidelines and essential requirements of hygiene for processing, handling and storage of cured fish and fishery products. NOTE — This code applies to sun-dried, salted and dried fish and fishery products.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specification fo Common salt for fish curing

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
